# Lorenzoz Agency

> A partner focused on the success of local businesses: first a free needs analysis, then the implementation of one tailored solution that brings new customers, built from local SEO, website development, an AI voice receptionist and custom software. Built by Héctor Luis Lorenzo Zaldivar (Founder & AI Architect) from Xinzo de Limia, Spain.

**Key facts**

- Founder: Héctor Luis Lorenzo Zaldivar, Founder & AI Architect
- Headquartered in Xinzo de Limia, Ourense, Spain
- Serves clients worldwide, with a primary focus on Australia, Canada, Costa Rica, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States
- How we work: a free first call analyzes what the business needs; the agency then proposes, quotes and implements one tailored solution, and measures the results with the client
- Services: Local SEO (authority content, authority on Google and AI, review management), website development, AI voice receptionist, software development; they are building blocks combined per client, none is a core offer, and a service may come included in the solution at no extra cost
- Tech stack: Astro, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare (CDN, Workers, Pages), Vitest, Playwright, Lighthouse CI
- Pricing: no price is published; every solution is tailored to the business and quoted after the free first call
- Terms: no quote includes VAT; the work starts with a first implementation for 500 EUR + VAT that commits both sides and takes the first steps, then a monthly fee tied to the results agreed in the proposal, covered by the new customers the solution brings in; no other price is published; there is no free trial
- Payment accepted: Bank Transfer, Credit Card, Stripe
- Languages: nine, every page in each: English (/en/), Spanish (/es/), British English (/en-gb/), Galician (/gl/), Portuguese (/pt/), Italian (/it/), French (/fr/), German (/de/) and Dutch (/nl/); the version of any /en/... URL in another language is the same path under that language's prefix, for example /es/...

## The Cost of Waiting

- [Cost of waiting calculator](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/#cost-of-waiting): A calculator on the home page, titled "What does doing nothing cost you?". It exists in every site language, at the same anchor under each language prefix (for example https://hlorenzoz.com/es/#cost-of-waiting). Its point is to help a business see what the customers it misses cost it, as a starting point for the free needs analysis.
- [What the visitor enters](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/#cost-of-waiting): the customers the business loses each working day, and what a first visit is worth to it in EUR. It starts at 1 customer worth 140 EUR (a check up plus a filling in the dental example below). The figures stay in the visitor's browser; the site's assistant only receives them when the visitor starts a conversation with it.
- [How the calculator counts](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/#cost-of-waiting): per day = customers lost per day x value of a first visit; per week = per day x 5; per month = per day x 5 x 52 / 12; per year = per day x 260 (5 working days a week, 52 weeks a year). It counts first visits only, before any return visit or referral.
- [Dental clinic example, OCU dental survey of 27 November 2024](https://www.ocu.org/organizacion/prensa/notas-de-prensa/2024/saluddental271124): median prices patients reported paying in Spain: check up or cleaning 60 EUR, filling 80 EUR, root canal 250 EUR, implant 1850 EUR, orthodontics 2000 EUR, each multiplied by one lost patient a day. It is an illustration of the arithmetic, not a forecast or a result. These are market prices of a client industry, not the agency's prices.

## Services

- [Services Hub](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/services/): Directory of all 4 service offerings, each with its deliverables, process, and FAQ. Each one is a building block of a solution tailored to the client.
- [Local SEO](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/services/local-seo/): Ranking on Google and recommendation by AI engines for local searches, with three pillars, all included: authority content, authority on Google and AI, and review management. Quoted after a free first call. The goal is the first position on Google for local searches; no ranking is guaranteed.
- [Website Development](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/services/website-development/): Custom, high speed websites and PWAs built to convert visitors into clients, with structured data, translations and llms.txt, plus hosting and maintenance when the solution needs them. Quoted after a free first call.
- [AI Voice Receptionist](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/services/ai-voice-receptionist/): AI voice agents that answer calls, schedule appointments, and handle FAQs 24/7. Quoted after a free first call.
- [Software Development](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/services/software-development/): Full stack products with a Flutter frontend and a robust backend, built for every device. Quoted after a free first call; the quote depends on the functional requirements.

## Portfolio Case Studies

- [Lorenzoz Agency (this site)](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/lorenzoz-agency/): Live project. Astro 7, Tailwind 4, Cloudflare CDN, Vitest + Playwright CI/CD, PageSpeed Insights 98 on mobile (2026-11-25), JSON-LD structured data, PWA support.
- [Dental Clinic Demo](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/dental-clinic-1/): Demo project for a dental clinic with Google Business Profile optimization, Next.js 16, full test coverage, 95%+ PageSpeed, PWA and structured data.
- [Real Estate Demo](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/real-estate/): Demo real estate listings site with property/rental browsing, GBP optimization, Next.js 16, full test suite, 95%+ PageSpeed, structured data.
- [Malaga Event Gear](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/malaga-event-gear/): Live client project (malagaeventgear.com) for event equipment rental with online booking, 93+ mobile PageSpeed, Local Business and Organization schema.
- [Massage Studio Demo](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/demo-massages/): Demo project for a massage studio with a filterable treatment menu, frictionless booking flow, editorial design, journal content written for SEO.
- [Investep App](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/investep-app/): Demo multibroker investment tracking app with consolidated portfolio dashboard, profitability projections, trade journal, Flutter + Hono + Cloudflare stack, admin console.
- [Vicron Lopez](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/vicron-lopez/): Live client project (www.vicronlopez.es) for a luxury and sports car rental business in Ourense, Galicia. Bilingual Spanish/English site with translated URLs and hreflang, filterable fleet, a page per vehicle with specs and booking, GDPR cookie consent.
- [Masajes Orisha](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/masajes-orisha/): Live client project (masajesorisha.com) for a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica. The production build of the massage studio concept: bilingual Spanish/English throughout, light and dark themes, a booking request in four steps that estimates the session before it is sent, and a fully translated journal.
- [GERP DJ](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/portfolio/gerp-dj/): Live client project (gerp-dj.com) for a party, wedding and event DJ in Ourense, Galicia. Published in Spanish and Galician with light and dark themes, a date request that opens WhatsApp ready to send, a gallery of ten video clips of performances and setups and a press dossier to download. PageSpeed Insights mobile, measured 2026-11-24: Performance 99, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100. Google Rich Results Test, tested 2026-11-24: 3 valid items (Breadcrumbs, Local business, Organisation).

## News

- [Lorenzoz Agency launches its website on Next.js 16](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/lorenzoz-agency-launch/): How the agency site was built and launched in April 2026 as a bilingual Next.js 16 static export on Cloudflare, with a GitHub Actions pipeline (73 unit tests, 45 end to end tests in five browsers, Lighthouse CI on 7 pages, run April 6, 2026) and a Rich Results Test of April 6, 2026 with valid FAQ, Local businesses and Organisation items.
- [Our website, rebuilt on Astro for a faster and more accessible visit](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/lorenzoz-agency-case-study/): The November 25, 2026 move of hlorenzoz.com from Next.js 16 to Astro 7 with identical URLs, head and JSON-LD on 48 pages; local Lighthouse mobile medians of the same day (home Performance 77 to 89, Total Blocking Time from 66 to 83 ms down to 0 ms, JavaScript per page from 534 to 645 KB down to 2.6 to 8.9 KB), Lighthouse accessibility 100 on every page, and the live PageSpeed Insights report (98 Performance, 100 Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO on mobile)
- [How we rebuilt Malaga Event Gear, from WordPress to a fast SvelteKit site](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/malaga-event-gear-study/): Case study of the AV rental site migrated from WordPress to SvelteKit on Cloudflare: fixed price packages, date request form, llms.txt, thirteen hreflang languages; PageSpeed Insights mobile on June 19, 2026 scored 93 Performance and 100 Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO, and the Rich Results Test (crawl June 18, 2026) found valid Breadcrumbs, Local business and Organisation.
- [How we built the Vicron Lopez website for luxury car rental in Ourense](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/vicron-lopez-case-study/): Case study of the bilingual SvelteKit site for a luxury car rental in Ourense: searchable fleet, vehicle pages with WhatsApp booking, translated URLs with hreflang, AutoRental and Car structured data, Lighthouse mobile lab run on November 25, 2026 (Performance 64, Accessibility 97, Best Practices 81, SEO 100).
- [How we built the Masajes Orisha website: SvelteKit, two languages and booking in four steps](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/masajes-orisha-case-study/): Case study (2026-07-24, updated 2026-11-25) of the Masajes Orisha website for a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica: SvelteKit served through Cloudflare, Spanish and English with hreflang, a filterable treatment menu, a booking request in four steps protected by Cloudflare Turnstile, a bilingual journal, AVIF and WebP images, DaySpa JSON-LD. Lighthouse mobile lab, measured 2026-11-25: Performance 82, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100.
- [Masajes Orisha joins the portfolio](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/masajes-orisha-portfolio/): Announcement (2026-11-24) that the website of Masajes Orisha, a live client project for a therapeutic massage studio in San Rafael de Heredia, Costa Rica, now has its own case study in the portfolio.
- [GERP DJ joins the portfolio](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/gerp-dj-added-to-portfolio/): Announcement (2026-11-24) that the website of GERP DJ, a live client project for a party, wedding and event DJ in Ourense, Galicia, now has its own case study in the portfolio.
- [How we built the GERP DJ website: Astro, two languages and WhatsApp bookings](https://hlorenzoz.com/en/news/gerp-dj-case-study/): Case study (2026-11-25) of the GERP DJ website for a party, wedding and event DJ in Ourense: Astro delivered through Cloudflare, Spanish and Galician with hreflang, a date request that opens WhatsApp, AVIF and WebP images, no tracking cookies, llms.txt. PageSpeed Insights mobile, measured 2026-11-24: Performance 99, Accessibility 100, Best Practices 100, SEO 100. Google Rich Results Test, tested 2026-11-24: 3 valid items (Breadcrumbs, Local business, Organisation).
